feed.title: Re: RFC: Two years of BIP Editing, time for some new faces?

entry.title: Re: RFC: Two years of BIP Editing, time for some new faces?
entry.summary:
Edil Medeiros demonstrates a strong commitment to the Bitcoin community, consistently engaging in meaningful contributions that reflect both dedication and expertise. His professional background aligns well with the skill set required for the role of BIP editor, ensuring that he is well-equipped to handle the responsibilities associated with this position.
Confidence in Edil's ability to excel stems from his proven track record and the positive influence he has already had within the community. His capacity to maintain and enhance the standards set by previous editors positions him as a valuable candidate poised to further advance the goals and integrity of the Bitcoin development process.
